response.what_it_is: Freestanding 4-burner gas and 2-burner electric cooker with oven
visible_condition: surface smudges and stains on glass lid
hidden_risks: Whether all four gas burners ignite and maintain a steady flame
Whether the two electric hotplates heat up properly
Functional status of the oven and internal thermostat

response.best_proof: A video demonstrating the gas burners lit and the electric hotplates switched on and heating up.
response.failure_mode: AI might overvalue based on the complete physical structure while ignoring potential internal faults in the electric hotplates, burners, or oven system.
